name: pbgc_plan_status
description: Look up a named pension plan sponsor's PBGC status: whether a pension plan was terminated and taken over by PBGC ("trusteed") because it was underfunded, or is still an active plan currently paying PBGC premiums (single-employer or multiemployer). Searches both PBGC registers by sponsor name, plan name, and/or employer EIN, and returns data_as_of so the caller knows how current each match is. Answers "did United Airlines' pension plan get taken over by PBGC", "is Acme Corp's pension plan still active", "what happened to the Enron pension plan". Example: pbgc_plan_status({ sponsor: "US Airways" }). Keyless.

sponsor.description: Plan sponsor / employer name, e.g. "US Airways"

name: pbgc_search_trusteed_plans
description: Search PBGC's register of single-employer pension plans PBGC has trusteed — i.e. taken over as trustee because the plan terminated underfunded. Returns case number, sponsor, plan name, EIN, termination date, date PBGC became trustee, and participant count at termination. Answers "pension plans PBGC has taken over in Illinois", "list trusteed plans for United Airlines", "biggest PBGC trusteeships by participants". Example: pbgc_search_trusteed_plans({ sponsor: "United Airlines" }); pbgc_search_trusteed_plans({ state: "IL", limit: 25 }). Keyless.

state.description: Two-letter US state code of the sponsor

name: pbgc_search_premium_filers
description: Search plans currently paying PBGC premiums — active pension plans (NOT terminated/trusteed), single-employer or multiemployer. Returns plan name, sponsor, admin city/state, EIN, plan effective date, and participant count. Answers "pension plans sponsored by Delta Air Lines", "multiemployer plans paying PBGC premiums in New York", "how many participants in the Acme Corp pension plan". Example: pbgc_search_premium_filers({ sponsor: "Delta Air Lines" }); pbgc_search_premium_filers({ state: "NY", plan_type: "multiemployer", limit: 25 }). Keyless.

state.description: Two-letter US state code of the plan administrator

name: pbgc_industry_totals
description: Aggregate counts across PBGC's registers: how many pension plans PBGC has trusteed (and total participants affected), and how many plans are currently paying premiums (single-employer vs multiemployer), optionally restricted to one US state. Answers "how many pension plans has PBGC taken over", "how many multiemployer plans pay PBGC premiums", "PBGC trusteeships in Texas". Example: pbgc_industry_totals({}); pbgc_industry_totals({ state: "TX" }). Keyless.

state.description: Restrict to one US state, e.g. "TX"
